title: Cyber Crime And Security
definition: Cyber Crime encompasses illegal activities where computers, networks, or digital devices are tools, targets, or places of criminal activity, while Cyber Security involves the protective measures, technologies, and policies safeguarding digital assets, critical infrastructure, and citizen data.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Prelims (IT Acts, CERT-In, malware, protocols) and Mains GS-3 (Internal security challenges, cross-border cyber terrorism, critical infrastructure protection, data governance).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Cyber Crime And Security.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of computer networks, internet protocols, and digital governance.
